notes_for_us: The prompt asks for a script, not a map. Roughly two thirds of it is MarketplaceService, gamepasses and GUI, and step 0 correctly routes all of it to mechanics — but nothing in intake tells the user that what comes back is a course with no shop in it, which is the part they will notice.

A screen-space shop has no destination. The enriched expansion invented a physical kiosk to give it somewhere to be, which is exactly the failure the ui destination exists to name and the handoff cannot record.

'Rainbow Fly to bypass stages' quietly contradicts the P6 guarantee — the course is validated as physics-legal for a walking avatar, and the prompt sells a tool that ignores it. There is no way to express 'validated route, plus an intended bypass'.
Stage count is one of the most basic obby parameters and the only place a number can live is count on a pick, so 'multi-stage' stayed a word.
